# Copilot Instructions

This project is a Flask Sudoku web application.

Guidelines for GitHub Copilot:

- Use Python best practices.
- Keep functions modular and reusable.
- Preserve Sudoku rules and unique-solution generation.
- Use clear variable names.
- Add comments for complex logic.
- Follow PEP 8 style.
- Use Flask conventions.
- Write simple, readable JavaScript and CSS.
- Do not remove existing functionality unless requested.
